exploit_name: Delayed swap collateral miscomputation inflates requirements for hedged positions
description: Uses max(loanRequirement, creditValue) instead of netting: max(0, loanRequirement - creditValue). Treats credit as alternative requirement floor.
root_cause: Uses max(loanRequirement, creditValue) instead of netting: max(0, loanRequirement - creditValue). Treats credit as alternative requirement floor.
fix_description: Compute: requirement = Math.max(0, loanRequirement - creditValue) to properly net offsetting positions.
notes: Artificially high collateral requirements cause solvent users to appear insolvent, triggering unfair liquidations.
